name: x-calc-a
hypothesis: The bottleneck is calculation depth: letting the model use forcing_lines to search checks and captures against every defence will find decoys, intermezzos and mating sacrifices it currently misses, and give it a verified line to explain.

name: x-calc-b
hypothesis: The bottleneck is perception and verification discipline: before trusting a capture or check, the model must audit defenders and replies with square_info and line_view. It also needs a breadth-first candidate list that includes sacrifices and in-between checks, under a call budget.
